decision.reasoning_trace: During the browsing session, I filtered out several products that were incorrectly listed as speakers but were actually accessories (cases, charging cables, and covers). My consideration set focuses on products with high ratings and verified sound performance. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) is the highest-performing device but carries a significantly higher price tag. The EWA (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) is popular for extreme portability and value but may lack the durability of brand-name alternatives. I selected the JBL Go 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_129) as my final choice because it offers an ideal balance of portability, brand reliability, and a high 4.7 rating. Reviews consistently praise its sound quality relative to its size, making it a reliable and high-value purchase for general outdoor or travel use.
